name: ANA LETÍCIA ALVES CLAUDIANO
title: Product Engineer (Full Stack & AI Systems)
summary: Product Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience specializing in full-stack architecture (TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL) and production AI/LLM systems. Proven track record owning platforms end-to-end in the EdTech sector, building tool-using agents, context assembly pipelines, and automated evaluation harnesses (deterministic checks, LLM judges). Daily power user of Claude Code and modern AI workflows to accelerate feature delivery, establish robust CI/CD, and translate ambiguous product requirements into high-impact user experiences.

items: LLM Application Development (Tool-Using Agents, Context Management)
Evaluation Systems (LLM Judges, Deterministic Checks, Threshold Calibration)
Hybrid Search & Retrieval (Sparse/Dense Retrieval, Reranking, Vector DBs)

experience.role: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack & Platform Lead)
bullets: Own end-to-end architecture and feature delivery for core EdTech platforms, shipping full-stack capabilities with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Python/Node.js services.

Architect and stand up production LLM agentic workflows and tool-calling interfaces with persistent sessions, dynamic context assembly, and vector search, replacing high-friction manual operational tasks.
Expand evaluation systems using deterministic checks and LLM-as-a-judge harnesses to monitor agent accuracy, eliminate behavioral drift, and maintain high metric fidelity.

Build streaming chat surfaces, operator interfaces, and reusable component libraries ([Live Demo](https://designsystemeadedo-git-202612-ana-leticias-projects-198dfb27.vercel.app/)) using Tailwind CSS and shadcn principles, ensuring sub-second response times.
Drive daily AI-assisted development workflows with Claude Code, accelerating end-to-end delivery, automated test scaffolding (Vitest, Playwright), and zero-downtime releases on AWS and Docker.
Owned production web applications from product discovery to deployment, making independent UX and architectural calls on complex workflows without prior specs or mockups.
Engineered scalable RESTful API endpoints and webhook handlers in Python and Node.js, integrating distributed services and managing multi-tenant PostgreSQL databases.
Automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Docker, enforcing strict quality gates, automated test coverage (Playwright, Jest), and predictable release cadence.
Led frontend system initiatives, designing accessible, component-driven interfaces that reduced user operational toil and accelerated cross-team feature adoption.
Engineered automated Python pipelines and anomaly detection models to process, validate, and analyze complex multidimensional datasets with high reliability.
Constructed deterministic validation rubrics and quality evaluation scripts to assess dataset integrity and model consistency for public decision-makers.
Maintained version-controlled repositories and reproducible workflows within an agile, collaborative research team.
